note: Lane swing_exec ports app/swing_execute.py and app/swing_live_gate.py. Neither mounts a route: POST /swing/execute and /swing/rearm are app/swing_desk.py's (the swing desk lane) and call execute_line / rearm_gtt. The confirm path is graded by the Rust tests in src/lanes/swing/swing_exec/tests.rs and tests/{py,track_c}.rs (every test of tests/test_swing_execute.py and tests/test_swing_track_c.py, by name); these cases pin the refusals that reach the execute module before any broker read, the success paths below, and that no order or GTT call reaches the replay Kite. Postgres backend: 5 of 5 EQUAL with equal order/GTT call logs (30 Oct 2026); risk_ledger.updated_at is the server's now(), masked as R8.6 documents. Review (30 Oct 2026) added nine cases on the bed's real expired sw_plan lines: 410 with the EXPIRED side effect and its re-post, 404 across plans, 400 on 'True', 422s, and the clock edges. public.sw_plan_line.updated_at is set by both stores' SQL `updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP` (the server's clock, which the injected clock cannot reach), masked as <null>/<set> exactly like risk_ledger.updated_at (R8.6); every other column, including state EXPIRED, is graded. Wave D2 (30 Oct 2026): desk_diff's "sql" key seeds a MORNING plan, three positions and a SENT live BUY on both clones, then drives every success path through the routes: a DRY_RUN BUY with its GTT, a 409 re-post, a PENDING_RANGE 400, a partial SELL (the integer GTT cancelled through the gateway, the remainder re-armed), a RAISE, a close-out SELL with r_multiple and pnl, /swing/reconcile, the 10:45 /swing/cutoff (the remainder cancelled through the gateway in DRY_RUN, the slot freed), and /swing/rearm on a naked, a covered and a closed position. The swing book builds no plan in the desk (the worker and the monitor do), so this lane adds no plans_*.json builder.

the close-out SELL books exit_avg, r_multiple, pnl and CLOSE_BELOW_TRAIL_MA
